metadata.label: Abstract
metadata.value: Wé Tenriabéng convinces her twin-brother that he’d better court I Wé Cudaiq, daughter of the king of Cina and granddaughter of La Urung Mpessi and Wé Pada Uleng. As soon as the wélenréng tree is cut and a ship is built, he sets off to the land of Cina, fighting many battles on his way. Three days later his twin-sister ascends to heaven.
